239)gsang mdzod kyi cha lag gnad kyi yig chung bsdus pa bzhugs so/bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/'dir rtsa gsum gang rung gi snyen sgrub la brtson par 'dod pa dag

tei:div.tei:p: 239)gsang mdzod kyi cha lag gnad kyi yig chung bsdus pa bzhugs so/ bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ 'dir rtsa gsum gang rung gi snyen sgrub la brtson par 'dod pa dag gis las gzhung gi phyag bzhes las byang rang rang gi gzhung ltar ma nor bar byas te/ yan lag gi cha rkyen gyi rim pa nyams su len pa la/ gnas kyi khyad par dang*/ yo byad kyi khyad par/ lag len gyi gnad dang gsum las/ dang po gnas kyi khyad par ni/ grong nag dang grong dgon lta bu ma yin pa/ sngon byon rgyal ba rnams kyis byin gyi brlabs pa'i gnas dang*/ gzhan yang sgrub gnas khyad par can dgra jag sogs kyi 'tshe ba med cing rang bzhin gyis dge sbyor 'phel ba'i gnas su gzhan la gsang bar byas nas rang gi gnas khang gi sta gon bsgrigs/ gnyis pa yo byad la'ang mchod pa dang*/ rdzas gnyis las/ mchod pa'i yo byad ni/ tshogs mchod mar me spos la sogs pa 'dod yon gyi mchod pa'i rten rnams dang*/ rdzas kyi yo byad dkyil 'khor gyi rten dang*/ dngos grub kyi rdzas 240)dang*/ sngags phreng rgyan ldan no/ phreng ba rab bho dhi tsit+ta/ 'bring byang chub shing 'bras/ tha ma pad+ma'i phreng ba sogs gas chag dang mes tshig pa/ dam nyams sdig can la sogs pa'i lag nas 'ong ba rnams spang bya yin la/ spus ldan yid du 'ong ba 'chang ba gnad yin/ de lta bu'i phreng ba de bzang drug gi chu'am chu gtsang gis bkrus la phreng thag kha dog lnga ldan dang*/ mdo 'dzin dkar dmar mthing gsum/ grangs tshad rnams kyang yid 'ong bya/ de ltar ldan pa'i phreng ba de rang gi yi dam gyi lha bsnyen skabs ma gtogs gzhan la mthong reg tsam yang mi bya bar gsang bar bya'o/ gsum pa lag len gyi gnad bsdus na/ sngar bshad pa'i mchod tshogs kyi yo byad dang*/ rang la nyer mkho'i zas gos la sogs pa gang dgos thams cad mtshams grol ma tshar bar du rtsol sgrub mi dgos pa'i sta gon rnams legs par bsgrigs mthar/

thog mar gnas khang phyag bdar byas nas bsang rdzas kyi dud pas bdug de nas gzhung bzhin dkyil 'khor bshams bkod thams cad sla thabs dang rang bzos ma bslad par legs par bshams/ de nas rang gi blo yang dag pa'i kun slong gi rtsis zin par 241)byas te mchod pa'i yo byad dang rang gi nyer spyad thams cad la ser sna dang 'bag btsog sogs kyi rkyen du mi gtong bar rnam gsum dag par byed do/ gos mi brje skra dang kha spu sen mo rnams mi 'breg rgyal tho phyi ma phan la rang phar mi 'gro zhing gzhan tshur mi gtong*/ gdan gyi drod dang bral bar mi bya zhing*/ dri gshang dor ba'i tshe sbyin par dmigs nas sngags kyi rgyun mi bcad/ bsnyen phreng gdan tshab la bzhag pa'am/ min kyang sngags grangs su mi brtsi/ gdan la 'khod pa dang mnyam du gzungs chus kha bkru zhing yang sngar ltar 'dzab sngags la 'jug gzhan yang glal ba dang*/ sbrid pa dang*/ glo lu ba sogs la sngags tshar bdun slar bskyar/ ting 'dzin ma gsal nas rmugs pa dang gnyid du phyogs pa la sngags brgya rtsa brgyad bskyar zlos bya/ lha sku dang khyad par thugs srog gsal snang cung zad ma thon bar du 'od zer spro bsdu'i dmigs pa gal mi che bas lha sku la gsal snang thon pa gal che/ gsal snang thon pa zhes pa de lha rang rgyud du 'dzin pa la zer ba min/ snang grags rig gsum lha sngags chos nyid ngang*/ gsungs pas na chos nyid gang du'ang 242)ma 'khrul pa'i gdangs las rig cha'i snang ba shar ba thams cad rten gzhal yas khang dang brten pa lha sku'i rnam par shar ba la bslab pa de la lha'i rnam pa gsal ba zer/ de ltar lhar snang cung zad brtan tshe thugs srog dang sngags phreng shin tu phra ba spu shad kyis bris pa lta bur gsal ngar thon tshe 'od zer spro bsdu'i dmigs gnad la brtson pas don gnyis kyi 'bras bu tshe 'dir thob nas phyag rgya chen po mchog gi rig 'dzin brnyes par 'gyur ro/

thun grol skabs rnams su'ang rang gi sgo gsum tha mal du ma song bar lhar snang dang mi 'bral ba'i ngang nas bza' btung la sogs tshogs 'khor gyi rang bzhin dang*/ 'gul bskyod thams cad phyag rgya gar gyi rnam rol du dmigs nas khyer so gsum ldan du bya/ zas rgog btsong mi za/ mer phu byed pa dang mchil ma sa la dor ba sogs mi bya/ gzhung gi sgrub pa la zhugs rjes phyi rol gyi mis rang mthong ba dang*/ rang gis gzhan la blta ba dang*/ tshig phrad byed pa ni sgrub pa'i spyang ki yin pas de nyid spong pa shin tu gal che'o/ khyad par du sgrub pa'i gnas dang yo byad dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub rten rdo rje phur bu sku gzugs bsnyen phreng lha'i ming dang dngos grub kyi rdzas sogs ni rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma ma gtogs 243)gzhan su gang la'ang shin tu gsang bar byed pa ni dam tshig gi gnad zab mo yin no/ thun mtshams kyi mchod pa kha gsos 'bru dang chu gtsang zur bkol du bzhag ste/ mchod kha gso ba las bsang chus mchod kha gso bar mi byed/ mchod pa'i rigs la bsang chu bran pa las bgegs gtor la bsang chu mi bran/ sman dang rak+ta'i thod snod ma nor bar bya zhing*/ mchod khag kyang bsre bar mi byed do/ tshogs mchod dang gtor zan rnams kyi rgyu mar khu dang chu gnyis cha mnyam gyis bag zan bca' ba las chu ha cang mang na dngos grub rgyang ring zhing bsod nams bri ba'i rgyu byed pas bag zan ran tshod kyis bca' ba dang*/ khyad par ser sna med cing ci yod spus ldan mchod par 'os pa'i rigs ma gtogs rang la ma mkho ba spus ngan pa mar rul ba dang*/ nas ngan gyi bag phye la sogs pa yid du mi 'ong ba'i kha zas rnams kyis mchod pa byed pa ni pre ta ka'i rgyu dngos su bsags pa yin pas spang bar bya'o/ mchod gtor rnams la dkar rgyan dang dmar rgyan la sogs gzhung bzhin legs par ma brgyan na lus srul por skye ba'i rgyur 'gro bas dkar skyong la dkar rgyan dang*/

gzhan rtsa 244)gsum sgrub gtor dang bka' srung gi gtor ma rnams la rang rang dang mthun pa'i mar gyis brgyan par bya'o/ bsnyen pa'i kha skong ngam gtang rag tu me tshogs gtong skabs me dkyil mdun bskyed kyi tshul du zhal sprod bya/ me mchod lhar dmigs nas sreg dkyil gyi mdun na mar me che ba gcig bzhag la/ de mchod pa'i lha mor gsal/ me hom sbar tshe lha mo der dmigs nas/ mar me sreg dkyil gyi shar lho'i mtshams su sbar ba'am gang bder bzhag go sreg rdzas rnams 'dod yon gyi mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab par sprul nas phul bas mdun bskyed lha'i ljags raṃ yig gis mtshan pas bdud rtsi'i bcud gsol bas thugs bde stong zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi ros tshims nas rnal 'byor sgrub pa po'i sgo gsum sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin du gyur par bsam pa sogs gzhung rang rang gi dmigs rim ltar bya/ sreg dkyil zhi rgyas gnyis la pad kha g.yas bkod du brtsigs shing*/ dbang drag gnyis sad kha g.yon bkod du brtsig par bya'o/ las bzhi gang yin gyi me tshogs 'bum ther la yam shing khri gcig dgos kyang skabs bstun mtshams lugs la brgya lnga bcu sogs gzhung nas gsungs pa ltar byas kyang 245)rung ngo/ mtshams grol mthar sbyin sreg gi tshig thal rnams zhi rgyas gnyis chu dpal bzang po dang*/ dbang drag gnyis ri mtho bkod legs kyi gnas su 'thor bar bya'o/ sgrub pa'i grogs kyang thabs la shes rab dang*/ shes rab la thabs gsungs pa'ang rlung bcu rang dbang dang ldan cing sngags kyi dgongs don tshul bzhin spyod pa la dgongs kyi deng dus de ltar dkon pas rang rang gi rigs dang mthun pa blo sems dkar ba chos la mos pa sdom dang dam tshig gtsang zhing dad dang shes rab che ba sogs chos bzhin spyod par byed pa gal che'o/ rjes su gtang rag gi tshogs mchod skabs bla ma dngos su bzhugs yod na de la rang gi ci 'byor gyi dngos rdzas dang tshogs kyi drang ba 'bul bar bya yi/

gzhan phal pa la tshogs rdzas tsam yang gsang bar rigs so/ mdor na sgrub pa la zhugs pa'i skabs sems bskyed thams cad rtsa ba nam mkhas gar khyab kyi sems can thams cad zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang la 'god par bya'o/ snyam pa'i bsam pa byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa gzhir bzhag pa smon sems dang*/ 'jug pa ni mchod tshogs sogs gtong ba sbyin pa/ phyi nang gi mi'i rgyu 'grul bcad cing rang gi ngag sgo 246)bsdams nas mi tshig mi smra ba dang*/ mtshams ma grol bar du srog la bab kyang dam rgya mi lhod pa tshul khrims/ thun bzhi la sogs phyag bzhes ji ltar yod pa bzhin thog ma nas bzung mtshams ma grol bar du le lo g.yeng ba mi byed par dam bca' brtan pa bzod pa/ thun dang thun mtshams rnams su sgo gsum lhar snang dang mi 'bral zhing bag med spang ba brtson 'grus/ rtsa gsum gang yin gyi dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par shar ba thams cad rang gi chos nyid kyi gdangs las g.yo ba med cing gang shar ye shes kyi rol par 'phos pas tha mal gyi 'dzin rtog dbyings su sangs pa las mi g.yo ba bsam gtan/ bskyed rim rang rgyud pa ma yin par chos nyid ma bcos pa'i ngang mdangs sam gsal cha ma 'gags pa las rang bzhin lhun grub tu 'char bar shes pa ni shes rab ste/ phyin drug gi yan lag rdzogs pa 'jug pa'i sems te/ de dag yang dag pa'i shes rab kyi rtsis zin pa ni don dam byang chub kyi sems zhes bskyed rdzogs thams cad kyi lam nyams su len pa'i sngon 'gro dang*/ dngos gzhi ting 'dzin gsum gyis gzhi bzung nas sgrub gzhung rang rang gi bskyed rim ltar byed pa gnad yin/ rjes rim tshogs mchod 247)gtong ba sogs ni mtha' rten gyi mjug don rim pas rdzogs pa'o/ de ltar bskyed rdzogs lam 'jug gnad yig 'di// snyigs ma'i 'gro la lhag par thugs brtse ba// ḍā ki'i rje mo ye shes mtsho rgyal gyi// thugs rje'i sprul pa mi mo'i gar bsgyur nas// gsang gtam tshul du gsungs pa bdag gis thos// mkhyen yangs blo gros ldan la mi mkho yang*// bdag dang bdag 'dra'i blo chung rigs rnams la// phan pa'i sems kyis yi ge'i ris su bris// dge 'dis 'gro kun rim gnyis mthar phyin nas// gdod ma'i gzhi ru sangs rgyas thob par shog
ces pa 'di yang rang slob thub bstan chos 'phel sogs slob 'bangs rnams kyi ched du snyoms las pa mdo med 'chol mo kun bzang bde skyong dbang mo'am su kha badz+ra gyis bris pa'o// dge'o// 248)
